notes: Imported verbatim from Ojas's T01 catalogue (policy/T01-outbound-templates/templates.csv); T01 is the source of truth for wording. Regenerate with backend/scripts/import_t01.py; never edit by hand.

Placeholders: T01 {x} -> {{x}}. Renamed where the meaning is identical: {link} -> {{payment_link}}, {emi} -> {{amount}} (per-row t01_placeholder_map makes it reversible). {unsubscribe_link} has no K22 equivalent and is kept as-is, so our checklist reports it.

Tier: T01 has none. Mapped from T01's tone ladder: B1 and B2 -> T2 (late charges), B3 -> T3, B4 -> T4. PRE_DUE rows are purpose PRE_DUE_REMINDER (no tier). Intensity follows the tier (T2 LOW, T3/T4 STANDARD).
Purpose: every T01 row is an outbound reminder (REMINDER, or PRE_DUE_REMINDER for PRE_DUE); angle E (date ask) stays REMINDER because K22's ASK_PAYMENT_DATE is a pre-verification reply, not outreach.

IVR / voicebot: split at T01's [OPENER] / [AFTER_CONFIRM] markers (t01_segments). IVR body = opener + ' ' + after_confirm as spoken; voicebot opening_line = opener, body = after_confirm. T01 IVR is interactive (keypad), K22 only knows the one-way ivr_blast type.

Provider fields are placeholders: SMS PENDING_DLT / PENDING_HEADER, WhatsApp UTILITY with a generated template name, IVR PENDING_RECORDING. Voicebot rows have NO Sarvam agent (none was built for T01), so our CHANNEL_REGISTRATION rule fails them by design.
approved / approval come from OUR checklist only. APPROVED_FOR_DEMO is not lender, DLT or Meta approval.
